About the Role

We're seeking a talented Fullstack WordPress Developer with strong expertise in custom theme and plugin development. You'll work on WordPress projects, including theme and plugin development, and potentially some Joomla projects (with appropriate support, depending on your familiarity).

This is a contract role for full-time work over a 5 month contract.

However, you'll work as if you were a full-time employee, participating in team meetings, communicating via Slack, and coordinating with other people on our team.

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Build custom WordPress themes that closely match designs with meticulous attention to detail
  • Develop custom WordPress plugins with clean, well-structured code
  • Take ownership of WordPress projects from concept to completion
  • Refactor and update existing themes and templates
  • Address other occasional full-stack developer tasks as needed for non-WordPress systems and situations (e.g. newsletter development)
  • Provide limited support for clients who have issues or problems (secondary responsibility)

 

Work Hours & Meetings

You must be available to participate in meetings between 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM Los Angeles time (UTC-8)

Your work hours will be negotiable. However, this is a full-time position, and the condition of this contract work is that you only work on our projects and on a full-time basis. Preference will be given to candidates that can closely align with our US timezone schedule.

You have:

  1. At least 4 years of experience building custom WordPress themes and plugins
  2. Strong front-end development skills with an eye for detail
  3. Deep understanding of code organization, patterns, and OOP
  4. Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)
  5. The ability to work independently and complete objectives without explicit direction
  6. The ability to deliver polished work, self-review, and catch bugs before others do. This means that for any front-end development you do, it should be near pixel-perfect in alignment with the design you're working from.

Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity

  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits

  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex.

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • Have two roles:

  • admin:

    • Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”.

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Build at least two n8n workflows:

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”.

  • Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository.

  • A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions.

  • A short note on what you would change to run this in production.

  • UX and practicality

  • Integration design, reliability, and error handling (n8n)

  • Documentation and reasoning

Real ownership: You set the direction for our platform from day one. No ticket queue, no layers of approval.

We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

We're hiring a Senior Technical Account Manager who has already done this job at a SaaS company: someone who has led complex implementations and owned enterprise relationships for the long haul, and who builds with AI rather than just using it.

TAMs at ClickUp are the long-term technical and strategic partner for a portfolio of enterprise customers. This isn't a relationship-only CSM role, and it's not an implementation role where you get buried in requests and lose the account strategy. You'll discover the business problem, build and implement the right solution, drive adoption, and prove the business impact, staying with your customers from first rollout through renewal and expansion, turning delivered value into a credible growth story.

What you'll do

Own your customers for the long term

  • Be the strategic and technical owner of a portfolio of enterprise accounts, from first rollout through renewal and expansion.

  • Build and grow champions across admins, operators, and executive stakeholders.

  • Monitor adoption, account health, and stakeholder engagement; spot risk early and build recovery or acceleration plans.

  • Run executive business reviews with a clear point of view on delivered business value, progress, opportunities, and priorities.

  • Drive renewal strategy with your account team and bring the commercial instincts to spot expansion signals and turn outcomes into strong value stories.

Design and deliver the solution

  • Lead discovery that maps current-state vs. future-state workflows (Intake → Execution → Reporting).

  • Lead complex implementations end to end: governance, architecture, process design, and rollout across multiple teams or business units.

  • Recover momentum when projects stall, priorities shift, or stakeholder alignment breaks down.

  • Know when to standardize, when to keep flexibility, and how to balance technical ambition with customer readiness.

Build with AI

  • Design, build, and scale ClickUp AI agents, automations, and workflows tied to real customer KPIs.

  • Advise customers on prompt design, agent architecture, and scaling AI use cases across teams.

  • Track AI usage and consumption against plan, and turn usage insight into new opportunities.

Drive adoption and change

  • Make adoption your mandate, not a milestone. Pair every solution with a structured enablement and change management plan so new ways of working actually take hold across teams rather than stopping with the project sponsor.

  • Define success measures and adoption milestones with your stakeholders before go-live, track them relentlessly, and course-correct early when usage signals turn negative.

  • Build a culture of adoption inside your accounts: champion networks, internal advocates, and team-level habits that keep ClickUp and AI central to how they work, not a tool they drift away from.

  • Treat low adoption as a commercial signal: a customer who isn't using the product is a customer who won't renew. Intervene before it becomes a renewal conversation.

Partner across ClickUp

  • Be the voice of the customer for Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support.

  • Keep ownership even when multiple teams are involved.

What we're looking for

Required

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing, post-sale SaaS role (Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Implementation, Solutions Consulting, or similar).

  • Direct experience leading enterprise SaaS implementations end to end, with multiple stakeholders.

  • A track record of owning long-term enterprise customer relationships and building champions.

  • Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI-powered workflows, agents, or automations in a business context.

  • Executive presence: confident with both hands-on operators and C-level stakeholders.

  • Strong judgment in ambiguity; you simplify complexity and keep momentum through change.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, Wrike, Jira, or a comparable work-management platform.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic tools such as Claude, n8n, Make, Zapier, or LangChain.

  • Technical aptitude with integrations, APIs, automation logic, and data modeling.

  • Experience carrying a renewal or expansion number (GRR, NRR).

What sets you apart

  • You've built something with AI that a team actually runs on, and you can walk us through how it works.

  • You think in workflows and systems, not just relationships.

  • You've run enterprise implementations and know change management firsthand.

  • You stay with customers long after go-live, and they want you there.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Privacy Notice

ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

Fraud Alert

ClickUp Talent Acquisition will only initiate contact via an @clickup.com email or through our official careers portal on clickup.com. We will never request fees, payments, or sensitive personal information. Please disregard any offers received outside these channels and report them to support@clickup.com.

AI Processing Notice

ClickUp may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to help review and screen candidates' employment applications against role-related criteria. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision‑making. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com.

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

As part of Lightspeed’s Support team, you will be the first point of contact for our customers who need assistance, helping with a wide variety of requests all the way from general education to hardware/software investigation and everything in between.

Working closely with various global teams at Lightspeed, you will investigate, troubleshoot, test and resolve issues that our hospitality customers may be facing during service.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Working with a truly global, multi-language 24x7 team across APAC, EMEA and NOAM

  • Flexibility on working days and shifts (weekends included)

  • Have enthusiastic, positive and knowledgeable interactions with our Hospitality customers, partners and Lightspeed team members, maintaining Lightspeed's Gold Class standard for support via phone, chat and email.

  • Use consistent troubleshooting techniques to quickly and efficiently identify the source of customer issues and provide a prompt and appropriate solution

  • Work within our customer support platforms to document, track and resolve interactions

  • Assist with the identification, reproduction and escalation of product issues and bugs to the Quality Assurance team, tracking through to resolution with each customer, partner and Lightspeed team member

  • Advocate and promote improvements to our products and services

  • Operating within a roster/schedule to ensure high availability of our assistance for our customers (In collaboration with your manager)

What you’ll be bringing to the team:

  • Previous customer service experience and/or technical support Strong attention to detail with an emphasis on providing an exceptional customer experience

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Dutch & English

  • Basic experience using common online, mobile and desktop platforms; iOS, Android, OSX, Windows

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

  • Experience interacting with customers through Phone, Email, Ticketing and Live Chat platforms

  • Experience or knowledge of the Hospitality industry

  • Experience supporting a SaaS product

  • Experience supporting an iOS application

  • Computer networking experience or interest

Even better if you have, but not necessary

  • Passion in technology;

  • Working knowledge of Mac OS and basic knowledge of HTML/CSS;

  • Hospitality experience;

  • French written and verbal communication skills;

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Please make sure to apply with a CV in English.


What’s in it for you:

  • PTO scheme

  • 400€ annually towards Health and Wellbeing

  • Dental cover

  • Private healthcare

  • Optical cover

  • Opportunity to join a growing team, in a fast-paced, high-growth company

  • Work with a team of incredibly talented and forward-thinking people!

  • Work for a team that values hard work, and knows how to celebrate the wins

  • Amazing benefits & perks, including equity for all Lightspeeders

In short, an opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed family, a true Canadian tech success story.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

jobs.description_html:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)

Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.

Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🩺 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from everyone. Even if you do not meet 100% of our musts, do not let it stop you. If this role excites you, we would love to hear from you.

About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

This company is far more than a traditional real estate brokerage — it is a tech-powered media company reinventing how real estate is bought, sold, and experienced, combining elite sales talent, cutting-edge technology, and world-class content creation to build a completely new industry approach; its ecosystem spans luxury residential real estate, a powerful education platform, and an in-house creative agency, forming a vertically integrated model that is reshaping the real estate landscape, while offering engineers the opportunity to join an organization that treats technology as a core strategic differentiator, empowers small, autonomous, high-impact teams with full ownership, and values great design, clean code, and exceptional user experience, all within a company that is actively building the future of real estate.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join a high-impact fintech-focused engineering team building resilient, scalable, and data-intensive systems. This role requires deep expertise across the full stack, from designing PostgreSQL schemas and distributed backend services to delivering polished React/Next.js user experiences. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who values reliability, operational excellence, and clean architecture, with experience handling complex financial workflows, asynchronous event processing, and high-stakes transactional data. You will work in a fast-paced environment with strong ownership, leveraging AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to deliver robust production-grade solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full lifecycle of product features, from database schema design and backend implementation to frontend delivery and production monitoring.

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable event-driven and distributed systems with strong guarantees around reliability and data consistency.

  • Develop and optimize complex PostgreSQL queries, migrations, and transactional workflows for high-performance financial operations.

  • Build resilient integrations with third-party systems using webhooks, queues, retry mechanisms, and reconciliation processes.

  • Implement reliability engineering patterns including idempotency, dead-letter queues (DLQs), outbox patterns, and fault-tolerant processing.

  • Create responsive and high-quality user interfaces using React and Next.js.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and continuously improve system scalability, observability, and operational excellence.

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar platforms to improve engineering productivity and accelerate delivery.

  • Participate in code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote best practices for handling sensitive financial and transactional data.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering stakeholders to deliver exceptional user experiences.

  • Implement and maintain observability and monitoring solutions using tools such as Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

  • Contribute to infrastructure automation and cloud resource management using Infrastructure as Code practices such as Terraform or Pulumi.

  • Ensure engineering practices align with security, compliance, and regulated-environment requirements including SOC2 and PCI-DSS standards where applicable.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Engineer delivering production-ready applications end-to-end.

  • Strong proficiency with TypeScript and Node.js.

  • Advanced experience with React and Next.js.

  • Deep expertise in PostgreSQL and database engineering, including raw SQL, query optimization, migrations, and performance analysis.

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining event-driven and distributed systems.

  • Strong understanding of reliability engineering patterns, including:

    • Idempotency keys and retry strategies

    • Dead-letter queues (DLQs)

    • Outbox patterns

    • Reconciliation processes for data consistency

  • Experience building webhook-driven architectures and integrating third-party systems.

  • Solid understanding of scalable system architecture, asynchronous processing, and fault-tolerant applications.

  • Experience working with financial, payments, billing, payroll, or ledgering systems.

  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or similar agentic coding platforms.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a systems-thinking mindset and attention to edge cases and data integrity.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work autonomously within high-impact engineering teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Pulumi.

  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog or OpenTelemetry.

  • Experience working in regulated or compliance-heavy environments, including SOC2 or PCI-DSS.

  • Knowledge of property-based testing frameworks such as fast-check for validating complex business logic.

  • Experience optimizing applications for scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.

  • Prior experience mentoring engineers and participating in technical leadership initiatives.

  • Experience working within fintech or high-transaction-volume platforms.

  • Exposure to modern AI-enhanced engineering workflows and automation practices.

  • Experience collaborating within autonomous, product-focused engineering teams.

  • Passion for clean architecture, exceptional user experience, and high-quality software craftsmanship.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

jobs.description_html:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Everything we build now runs through one question: how do we supercharge productivity with AI?

ClickUp Brain and our agentic AI capabilities are the center of gravity for the company. We're not bolting AI onto a project management tool, we're building the platform where AI does real work: drafting, summarizing, routing, researching, and executing alongside the humans who use it. That focus is external and internal. We expect our customers to get radically more productive with AI, and we expect the same of ourselves. Every ClickUp employee is given the tools, the training, and the mandate to use AI in their daily workflow.

This is an AI-native role. You will use AI every day to research faster, personalize at scale, prep calls, and keep your pipeline clean. You will also be selling AI, so you need to speak about it credibly.

The Role

As a Market Development Representative (MDR), you'll serve as the critical bridge between our marketing efforts and the sales team, playing a pivotal role in accelerating our revenue pipeline. You will be responsible for meticulously following up on, nurturing, and qualifying all inbound leads generated from our diverse marketing channels. This role is fundamental to ensuring our sales team engages only with the most promising and well-prepared prospects.

In this position, you'll act as the first point of contact and a trusted educator for potential customers. Your mission is to understand their initial interest, assess their business needs, and articulate the value of our platform, including how our AI capabilities change what their team is capable of. You will manage the crucial early stages of the buyer's journey, building rapport and filtering for high-potential opportunities before seamlessly transitioning them to an Account Executive.

This is a high-velocity motion: sub-30 day cycles, pipeline generation at scale, and relentless execution. MDRs don't win by out-strategizing over weeks. They win by out-hustling, out-qualifying, and out-persisting, turning every inbound signal into a qualified opportunity that sticks downstream.

How We Hire, Coach and Measure: The Four Pillars

Every MDR is developed and evaluated against four behavioral pillars. They're not corporate values on a wall, they're the operating system of the team.

🔥 Ownership. The non-negotiable foundation. Extreme ownership of pipeline outcomes and no excuses when a lead goes cold because you didn't respond fast enough or log your work properly. Intellectual honesty: truth over ego. Going above and beyond for the team's collective success, not just your own number.

⭐️ Obsession. The refusal to plateau. This is a high-rejection motion, so you study objection patterns, perfect talk tracks, and learn from every no. You compound knowledge: every call makes the next one better because you document what works and share it.

⚡️ Effectiveness. Winning by design, not effort alone. Converting high volume into high quality through sharp qualification, deep discovery, and meetings that actually stick. Every touch is chosen for maximum conversion impact.

🤖 AI Native. Using AI to amplify your own output, and positioning ClickUp's AI credibly to prospects. The bar: you're leveraging AI across research, outreach, follow-up, and CRM hygiene, and you can articulate our agentic AI value proposition in every qualification conversation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond promptly (Zoom, phone, email) to all inbound leads generated by marketing activities: handraisers, account signals, content, webinars, social campaigns, and events.

  • Qualify marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) using a consistent framework to determine sales readiness and fit, and distinguish buyers from browsers.

  • Nurture leads through in-depth conversations, acting as an educator and advisor rather than focusing solely on immediate conversions.

  • Uncover real business pain beneath surface-level inquiries, quantify its impact, and document it clearly for the AE.

  • Position ClickUp's platform and agentic AI capabilities credibly and specifically, mapping them to the prospect's actual workflow gaps.

  • Use AI tools across your entire workflow: account and persona research, personalization at scale, call prep, follow-up drafting, and CRM hygiene. Edit every output for authenticity, never ship raw.

  • Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead interactions and qualification status in CRM.

  • Deliver comprehensive AE handoffs with a qualification summary, roles identified, pain documented, and competitive context.

  • Provide detailed feedback to sales and marketing on lead quality, content effectiveness, and channel performance, helping refine messaging and targeting.

  • Occasionally perform cold outreach as needed, with a primary focus on inbound.

  • Share what works: talk tracks, AI workflows, and objection patterns. Individual wins are good, team adoption is better.

Qualifications

This role is built for a highly motivated and tenacious individual who is eager to succeed and thrives on hard work. The most important qualifications are your personal drive and resilience, as you'll be connecting with a high volume of customers daily.

Associate Director, Strategic Program Management, CDx/IVD

Position Overview

Natera is seeking an Associate Director of Strategic Program Management to lead IVD and companion diagnostic (CDx) programs from development planning through PMA submission. This leader will shape the development strategy with functional experts and own the integrated execution plan across assay development, software and bioinformatics, analytical and clinical validation, laboratory operations, Quality, and Regulatory Affairs.

The Associate Director will bring clarity to complex programs, connect decisions across workstreams, and drive teams toward critical development and submission milestones. This is a highly visible role requiring the ability to lead without direct authority, resolve competing priorities, and present clear recommendations to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT). The role focuses on internal CDx development and execution; dedicated partnership leaders own external pharmaceutical partner management.

Primary Responsibilities

Lead IVD/CDx program execution

  • Lead complex IVD/CDx programs through development, design transfer, validation, and PMA submission.
  • Build and maintain an integrated program plan covering deliverables, resources, dependencies, decision points, and regulatory milestones.
  • Partner with functional leaders to define objectives, development priorities, success criteria, and executable plans.
  • Anticipate risks, identify gaps and trade-offs, and drive timely decisions across functions.
  • Establish clear program governance, ownership, escalation paths, and accountability for commitments.

Drive development and submission readiness

  • Integrate assay development, design controls, software and bioinformatics, analytical validation, clinical validation, laboratory implementation, and submission activities.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs and Quality to align program execution with FDA interactions, applicable requirements, and PMA evidence needs.
  • Coordinate plans for assay changes, comparability or bridging studies, and transition to the final CDx configuration, as applicable.
  • Lead reviews at major development gates to confirm deliverables, readiness criteria, open risks, and decisions.
  • Track submission-critical evidence and documentation, and drive resolution of gaps that could affect PMA quality or timing.

Provide executive leadership and communication

  • Present program strategy, progress, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to the ELT and other senior governance forums.
  • Translate complex scientific, operational, and regulatory issues into concise, data-backed options and decisions.
  • Build alignment among leaders with different priorities and hold teams accountable for agreed actions and milestones.
  • Escalate material issues early, with a clear assessment of their impact and a recommended path forward.
  • Provide the internal program status and decision support needed by colleagues who lead external pharmaceutical partner relationships.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive program or project management experience in molecular diagnostics, in vitro diagnostics, medical devices, biotechnology, or a related regulated field.
  • Direct experience leading CDx or IVD development programs involving design controls, validation planning, and FDA submission preparation.
  • Experience building and driving integrated plans across technical, clinical, regulatory, quality, software, and operations functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead senior cross-functional stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and deliver results without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience presenting complex programs, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Strong ability to connect technical decisions, resource needs, regulatory evidence, and timelines to the overall program strategy.

Preferred

  • Experience leading a CDx or IVD program through PMA submission or a major PMA milestone.
  • Experience with next generation sequencing, genomic diagnostics, or biomarker-defined patient populations.
  • Experience coordinating analytical and clinical validation strategies and managing changes between clinical trial and final commercial assay configurations.
  • Familiarity with pharmaceutical development timelines and the dependencies between a therapeutic program and its companion diagnostic.
  • Advanced degree or program management certification.

Leadership Expectations

The successful candidate will lead the program beyond milestone tracking. They will understand the science and regulatory strategy well enough to ask informed questions, recognize when a decision in one workstream creates risk elsewhere, and bring the right leaders together to resolve it. They will foster trust and open discussion, make ownership clear, and give executives an accurate view of progress and the decisions needed to deliver the program.

Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process around 10 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Risk Operations Center, the AI platform where lean security teams run cyber risk end to end. It combines security ratings, threat intelligence and AI agents to give teams one view of risk across their vendors, attack surface and workforce.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Where does this role fit in?

You’ll be UpGuard’s first marketer in EMEA, making sure the region gets what it needs to grow. That means two things. First, you’ll deliver partner marketing across EMEA, running programs and events with our channel and technology partners that create pipeline. Second, you’ll be the main marketing contact for the region, working with EMEA sales leaders every week and with our global marketing team to make sure events, campaigns, content, and collateral land well in local markets.

You won’t be expected to do everything yourself. Global teams own demand generation, product marketing, content, and brand. Your job is to bring the region’s needs to them, adapt what they build for EMEA, and run the activity that only someone on the ground can, especially partner events. You’ll work from a regional plan and budget. This is a hands-on role, and success is measured by the pipeline you help create.

What will you do?

  • Be the main marketing contact for EMEA, with a standing weekly check-in with regional sales leaders

  • Deliver the EMEA partner marketing plan agreed with your manager and our channel team, running joint campaigns, webinars, and enablement content with the resellers, MSPs, and technology partners most likely to produce pipeline.

  • Manage and organise EMEA partner events end to end, including co-hosted roundtables and executive dinners, sponsored partner conferences, and partner enablement sessions. That covers venue and vendor sourcing, logistics, joint promotion, on-site delivery, and making sure leads are shared and followed up with partners and sales.

  • Work with sales and demand gen on account-based programs and regional campaigns, coordinating events, outreach, and content around target accounts and contributing to regional lead generation.

  • Build UpGuard’s presence in the region through EMEA customer stories, references, and speakers, regional PR and media, and relationships with industry associations and CISO communities (e.g. ISACA and ISC2 chapters).

  • Localize global campaigns, content, and collateral for EMEA markets and languages, and feed regional regulatory developments (e.g. NIS2, DORA, GDPR) to product marketing so our messaging stays relevant.

  • Track market development funds and co-marketing spend for partner events and campaigns, and partner-sourced and influenced pipeline in the CRM, within agreed budgets.

  • Report on regional and partner performance against agreed goals, and share insights and recommendations to inform future plans.

What will you bring?

  • 6+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with significant time in partner/channel marketing, field marketing, or regional marketing in EMEA.

  • Experience selling to security, IT, risk, or compliance buyers, ideally in cybersecurity.

  • A track record of partner or regional programs that produced measurable pipeline.

  • Experience running account-based programs with sales, and building customer advocacy or regional PR.

  • Comfort working as a team of one in-region while collaborating closely with a global team across time zones.

  • Strong relationships with sales leaders and an instinct for turning field feedback into marketing action.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce or HubSpot and of partner and event attribution.

  • Willingness to travel across EMEA.

What will give you an edge?

  • Knowledge of EMEA's security regulatory landscape, existing relationships with major regional distributors, MSPs, media, or CISO communities

  • Fluency in a second European language

About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role:

We’re hiring a design leader to own the experience of AlphaSense’s most important frontier: the AI-native, agentic product our customers use to build on proprietary financial data.

AlphaSense is shifting from a research library into an end-to-end workflow platform: a "super analyst" with agentic, computer-use capabilities that lets analysts go from question to discovery to synthesis to finished work product (dashboards, decks, models, generated outputs) without leaving the platform. It’s an enormous opportunity, and today the experience is fragmented: years of incremental features, two search paradigms that don’t yet converge, no self-service onboarding, and a wide spectrum of AI fluency across our users.

You will own the design vision for the AI experience and lead a small team to ship it. You’ll set a clear point of view on where the UX is going, collaborate with Product and Engineering while constructively challenging decisions to raise the bar, and turn an ambiguous, cross-team problem space into a coherent, high-quality, trustworthy product.

This is a player-coach role: like all of our directors, you’ll lead a small team of senior designers while staying hands-on with the craft. We’re open to hiring at Director or Senior Director, depending on scope and experience, with a preference for candidates located in NYC, in a similar time zone, or able to travel.

Why this role matters

At AlphaSense, design is a core driver of how we win. As we build an AI-native platform, the quality of our user experience will define how effectively customers can navigate complexity, build conviction, and make high-stakes financial decisions with confidence.

In this role, you will set that standard through the AI experience you shape, the team you grow, and the craft bar you hold across the product.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set the UX direction for the core AI / agentic experience: a clear, opinionated vision for how analysts work with AI on high-stakes financial decisions, and a sequenced path from today’s product to that north star.
  • Lead through influence and craft: partner with an SVP of Product and multiple PMs (across NY and the UK), advocating for the best experience while working through business goals, timelines, and technical constraints to decide the real first step.
  • Solve the hard, data-dense UX problems: malleable UI with sensible defaults for hedge funds and banks (without overwhelming them), taming information overload, trust and transparency in AI-mediated workflows (citations, confidence, control, reversibility), and cohesion across surfaces.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype in code and with real data, contribute directly to the highest-leverage surfaces, and set the craft bar by doing the work, not just reviewing it.
  • Raise the bar for AI-native design: define how AI shows up as a first-party capability across the product, not just in one agentic pane.
  • Help evolve our foundations: contribute to a design system being rebuilt to be code- and AI-readable.
  • Coach, grow, and care for a small team of senior designers: modeling the craft, giving sharp feedback, and creating the conditions for them to own outcomes end-to-end.
  • Hire and level thoughtfully as the team grows, keeping the org flat and the talent bar high.
  • Multiply the team’s impact through operating mechanisms (UX audits, opportunity maps, product narratives, design reviews, and clear quality bars) rather than personal output alone.
  • Communicate persuasively upward, including to VP/C-level, grounding proposals in customer evidence and business outcomes.

Who You Are:

  • A senior product-design leader with 10+ years of relevant design experience at technical and product-driven companies (3+ years in people management preferred), and a track record of owning a major product area’s experience and shipping it, ideally in complex, data-dense, or expert-user domains.
  • Strong, well-argued opinions held with humility: you shape direction and create healthy friction, and you update your view when the evidence changes.
  • Genuine AI-native product judgment: not just content generation, but designing for trust, control, and workflow transformation in agentic and probabilistic systems.
  • Hands-on craft and technical fluency: comfortable prototyping in code (React / modern front-end an advantage) and using AI tools in your workflow; credible to designers and engineers alike.
  • People leadership: evidence you can model, coach, and care for a team, not only align stakeholders. (For candidates newer to formal management, we’ll look for strong player-coach signals and a real motivation to develop others.)
  • Excellent communication and collaboration with both technical and non-technical partners, and comfort operating in ambiguity across teams.
  • Curiosity about (or experience in) financial services, fintech, or other high-stakes professional domains. Domain expertise is a strong plus; a serious, humble approach to ramping into it is essential.

You’ll partner closely with hiring managers, senior leaders, and clients across multiple regions, helping to deliver hiring strategies that support our continued growth. Acting as both a talent advisor and brand ambassador, you’ll build strong candidate pipelines, provide market insights, and ensure an exceptional experience throughout the hiring process.

This is a highly collaborative, commercially focused role where success is measured not only by hiring outcomes but also by the quality of stakeholder partnerships, candidate experience, and the ability to influence hiring decisions through data and market intelligence.

  • Source, engage, and assess high-quality talent across Technology, Consulting, Sales, and Operations functions

  • Present candidates to hiring managers and clients, providing clear assessments, market insights, and hiring recommendations

  • Work directly with clients and delivery teams to support talent augmentation and client hiring requirements
  • Act as a brand ambassador for Massive Rocket, strengthening our employer brand across key talent markets
  • Maintain accurate recruitment data and reporting through ATS platforms and sourcing tools
  • Leverage AI and recruitment technology to improve sourcing effectiveness, operational efficiency, and candidate engagement

  • 3–4+ years of recruitment experience, with a strong track record hiring across technical, consulting, sales, or operational functions
  • Proven experience managing full-cycle recruitment processes in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Strong sourcing expertise using LinkedIn, talent mapping techniques, and modern recruitment technologies
  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing hiring decisions through data and market insights

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging candidates, hiring managers, clients, and senior leaders
  • Experience using ATS platforms such as Lever, Workable, Greenhouse, or similar recruitment systems
  • Commercial mindset with the ability to balance hiring quality, speed, and business priorities
